title: Banner animator
desc: Designs one HTML5 banner across every ad size, animates it on a shared timeline, and exports Google Ads zips and MP4 video.

title: Banner compressor
desc: Shrinks HTML5 banner zips to fit an ad network's size limit, re-encoding images and fixing the file references to match.

title: Banner tester
desc: Previews a batch of HTML5 banners side by side, flags missing files and fonts, and exports a page to share.

title: Frame grabber
desc: Steps through a video frame by frame and saves any frame as a full-resolution PNG or JPG, for posters and thumbnails.

title: File converter
desc: Converts images, video, audio, PDFs, documents and spreadsheets between formats, one file or a whole batch.

title: Case page builder
desc: Builds a case page for this portfolio from a form, with a live desktop and mobile preview, plus its homepage card entry.

title: CV editor
desc: Edits the CV as text with a live A4 preview, and downloads it as a one-page PDF.
